Costumes are unlockable items that can be used to change the appearance of Pio or Tia. Each character has a different set of costumes they can wear. Certain costumes are not included in the game by default and are automatically downloaded when selected. Costumes are purely cosmetic and do not serve any other gameplay purpose aside from changing the character's appearance.

List of costumes[]

Nyan tickets and rubies are consumed upon purchasing, whereas stars are not.
